verdict.rationale: Sift exposes a broad set of REST APIs (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows) covering most core fraud-fighting actions, suggesting strong API-first design, but no evidence explicitly confirms full functional parity between the API and the UI (e.g., whether Review Queue management, custom Workflow building, or dashboard analytics are fully API-accessible). Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, evidence of UI-only features being API-accessible, and independent confirmation of complete feature coverage via API.
